queries.text:
Process_ProcessDetail
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(Host)
| summarize by Value = Host
| order by Value asc

Process_ProcessDetail
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(ProcUser)
| summarize by Value = ProcUser
| order by Value asc

let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
Process_ProcessDetail
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where SessionID > 0
| join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
| extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
| where isnotempty(Application)
| summarize by Value = Application
| order by Value asc

Process_ProcessDetail
| where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
| where isnotempty(ProcName)
| summarize by Value = ProcName
| order by Value asc

datatable(Value:string)
[
    "CPU",
    "Memory",
    "IOPS",
    "Network"
]

datatable(Value:string)
[
    "5m",

    "30m",

]

datatable(Value:long)

let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let ProcessBase =
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
let Summary =
    ProcessBase
    | summarize
        Applications = dcount(Application),
        Users = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
        Hosts = dcount(Host),
        Sessions = dcount(strcat(Host, "|", tostring(SessionID))),
        ProcessInstances = dcount(ProcGUID),
        ProcessSamples = count();
union
    (Summary | project Metric = "Applications", MetricValue = todouble(Applications)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Users", MetricValue = todouble(Users)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Hosts", MetricValue = todouble(Hosts)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Sessions", MetricValue = todouble(Sessions)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Process Instances", MetricValue = todouble(ProcessInstances)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Process Samples", MetricValue = todouble(ProcessSamples))

let TopN = tolong(_topN);
let AppMap =

    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let ProcessBase =

    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
ProcessBase
| summarize
    Users = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    Sessions = dcount(strcat(Host, "|", tostring(SessionID))),
    ProcessInstances = dcount(ProcGUID),
    ProcessNames = dcount(ProcName),

let TopN = tolong(_topN);
let TimeBin = totimespan(_timeBin);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping

let ProcessBase =
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
let ApplicationSeries =
    ProcessBase
    | extend ProcessInstance = iff(
        isnotempty(tostring(ProcGUID)),
        tostring(ProcGUID),
        strcat(Host, ":", tostring(ProcID))
    )
    | summarize
        ProcessCPUPercent = avg(ProcCPUPercent),
        ProcessMemoryMB = avg(ProcWorkingSetMB),
        ProcessReadIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSRead),
        ProcessWriteIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSWrite),
        ProcessNetworkKBPS = avg(ProcNetKBPS)
        by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin), Application, ProcessInstance
    | summarize
        CPUPercent = sum(ProcessCPUPercent),
        MemoryMB = sum(ProcessMemoryMB),
        ReadIOPS = sum(ProcessReadIOPS),
        WriteIOPS = sum(ProcessWriteIOPS),
        NetworkKBPS = sum(ProcessNetworkKBPS),
        ActiveProcessInstances = dcount(ProcessInstance)
        by TimeBucket, Application
    | extend TotalIOPS = ReadIOPS + WriteIOPS;
ApplicationSeries
| summarize
    AvgCPUPercent = round(avg(CPUPercent), 2),
    P95CPUPercent = round(percentile(CPUPercent, 95), 2),
    MaxCPUPercent = round(max(CPUPercent), 2),
    AvgMemoryMB = round(avg(MemoryMB), 2),
    P95MemoryMB = round(percentile(MemoryMB, 95), 2),
    MaxMemoryMB = round(max(MemoryMB), 2),
    AvgIOPS = round(avg(TotalIOPS), 2),
    P95IOPS = round(percentile(TotalIOPS, 95), 2),
    AvgNetworkKBPS = round(avg(NetworkKBPS), 2),
    P95NetworkKBPS = round(percentile(NetworkKBPS, 95), 2),
    MaxActiveProcesses = max(ActiveProcessInstances)
    by Application
| top TopN by P95CPUPercent desc

let DefaultApplications =
    MetricSeries
    | summarize P95MetricValue = percentile(MetricValue, 95) by Application
    | top DefaultSeriesCount by P95MetricValue desc
    | project Application;
MetricSeries
| where Application in (_application)
    or (isempty(_application) and Application in (DefaultApplications))
| project
    TimeBucket,
    Application,
    MetricValue = round(MetricValue, 2)
| order by TimeBucket asc, Application asc

    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)

let ErrorBase =
    Application_Errors
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)

let Summary =

        TotalErrors = count(),
        Crashes = countif(ErrorType == 2),
        Hangs = countif(ErrorType == 1),
        AffectedApplications = dcount(Application),
        AffectedUsers = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
        AffectedHosts = dcount(Host);
union
    (Summary | project Metric = "Total Errors", MetricValue = todouble(TotalErrors)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Crashes", MetricValue = todouble(Crashes)),

    (Summary | project Metric = "Affected Applications", MetricValue = todouble(AffectedApplications)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Affected Users", MetricValue = todouble(AffectedUsers)),
    (Summary | project Metric = "Affected Hosts", MetricValue = todouble(AffectedHosts))

    | extend ProcessInstance = iff(
        isnotempty(tostring(ProcGUID)),
        tostring(ProcGUID),
        strcat(Host, ":", tostring(ProcID))
    )
    | summarize
        ProcessCPUPercent = avg(ProcCPUPercent),
        ProcessMemoryMB = avg(ProcWorkingSetMB),
        ProcessReadIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSRead),
        ProcessWriteIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSWrite),
        ProcessNetworkKBPS = avg(ProcNetKBPS)
        by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin), Application, ProcessInstance
    | summarize
        CPUPercent = sum(ProcessCPUPercent),
        MemoryMB = sum(ProcessMemoryMB),
        ReadIOPS = sum(ProcessReadIOPS),
        WriteIOPS = sum(ProcessWriteIOPS),
        NetworkKBPS = sum(ProcessNetworkKBPS),
        ActiveProcessInstances = dcount(ProcessInstance)
        by TimeBucket, Application
    | extend TotalIOPS = ReadIOPS + WriteIOPS;
ApplicationSeries
| summarize
    Average = round(avg(NetworkKBPS), 2),
    P95NetworkKBPS = round(percentile(NetworkKBPS, 95), 2),
    Maximum = round(max(NetworkKBPS), 2)
    by Application
| top TopN by P95NetworkKBPS desc
| project Application, MetricValue = P95NetworkKBPS, Average, Maximum

let Metric = tostring(_metric);
let DefaultSeriesCount = 5;
let TimeBin = totimespan(_timeBin);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let ProcessBase =
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
let ApplicationSeries =
    ProcessBase
    | extend ProcessInstance = iff(
        isnotempty(tostring(ProcGUID)),
        tostring(ProcGUID),
        strcat(Host, ":", tostring(ProcID))
    )
    | summarize
        ProcessCPUPercent = avg(ProcCPUPercent),
        ProcessMemoryMB = avg(ProcWorkingSetMB),
        ProcessReadIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSRead),
        ProcessWriteIOPS = avg(ProcIOPSWrite),
        ProcessNetworkKBPS = avg(ProcNetKBPS)
        by TimeBucket = bin(Timestamp, TimeBin), Application, ProcessInstance
    | summarize
        CPUPercent = sum(ProcessCPUPercent),
        MemoryMB = sum(ProcessMemoryMB),
        ReadIOPS = sum(ProcessReadIOPS),
        WriteIOPS = sum(ProcessWriteIOPS),
        NetworkKBPS = sum(ProcessNetworkKBPS),
        ActiveProcessInstances = dcount(ProcessInstance)
        by TimeBucket, Application
    | extend TotalIOPS = ReadIOPS + WriteIOPS;
let MetricSeries =
    ApplicationSeries
    | extend MetricValue = case(
        Metric == "CPU", CPUPercent,
        Metric == "Memory", MemoryMB,
        Metric == "IOPS", TotalIOPS,
        Metric == "Network", NetworkKBPS,
        CPUPercent
    );
let DefaultApplications =
    MetricSeries
    | summarize P95MetricValue = percentile(MetricValue, 95) by Application
    | top DefaultSeriesCount by P95MetricValue desc
    | project Application;
MetricSeries
| where Application in (_application)
    or (isempty(_application) and Application in (DefaultApplications))
| project
    TimeBucket,
    Application,
    MetricValue = round(MetricValue, 2)
| order by TimeBucket asc, Application asc

let TopN = tolong(_topN);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let ProcessBase =
    Process_ProcessDetail
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where SessionID > 0
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
ProcessBase
| summarize
    Users = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    Sessions = dcount(strcat(Host, "|", tostring(SessionID))),
    ProcessInstances = dcount(ProcGUID),
    ProcessNames = dcount(ProcName),
    Versions = dcountif(AppVersion, isnotempty(AppVersion)),
    Samples = count(),
    FirstSeen = min(Timestamp),
    LastSeen = max(Timestamp)
    by Application
| top TopN by Users desc

let TopN = tolong(_topN);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let ErrorBase =
    Application_Errors
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
ErrorBase
| summarize
    Errors = count(),
    Crashes = countif(ErrorType == 2),
    Hangs = countif(ErrorType == 1),
    Users = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    LastError = max(Timestamp)
    by Application
| top TopN by Errors desc

let TopN = tolong(_topN);
let AppMap =
    Application_AppNameIdMapping
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where isnotempty(AppId)
    | summarize arg_max(Timestamp, AppName) by Host, AppId
    | project Host, AppId, AppName;
let StartupBase =
    Process_ProcessStartup
    | where Timestamp between (_startTime .. _endTime)
    | where Host in (_host) or isempty(_host)
    | where ProcUser in (_user) or isempty(_user)
    | where ProcName in (_process) or isempty(_process)
    | join kind=leftouter AppMap on Host, AppId
    | extend Application = iff(isnotempty(AppName), AppName, ProcName)
    | where isnotempty(Application)
    | where Application in (_application) or isempty(_application);
StartupBase
| summarize
    Startups = count(),
    Users = dcountif(ProcUser, isnotempty(ProcUser)),
    Hosts = dcount(Host),
    AverageStartupMs = round(avg(toreal(StartupTimeMs)), 2),
    P95StartupMs = round(percentile(toreal(StartupTimeMs), 95), 2),
    MaximumStartupMs = max(StartupTimeMs),
    AverageStartupIOPS = round(avg(StartupIOPS), 2)
    by Application
| extend
    AverageStartupSeconds = round(AverageStartupMs / 1000.0, 2),
    P95StartupSeconds = round(P95StartupMs / 1000.0, 2),
    MaximumStartupSeconds = round(todouble(MaximumStartupMs) / 1000.0, 2)
| top TopN by P95StartupMs desc
| project Application, MetricValue = P95StartupSeconds, Startups, AverageStartupSeconds, MaximumStartupSeconds, AverageStartupIOPS, Users, Hosts
